comparison.objective: Unlatch and remove one DIN-rail terminal without disturbing neighbors; candidate screens mixed loose bodies.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool-assisted latch release and selective extraction versus bimanual screen handling and particle-flow control.
comparison.success_condition: Target terminal released into tray with rail/neighbors undisturbed versus media recovered and every washer retained.
comparison.reason: Selective component removal is materially different from bulk size/orientation separation.
